topic.title: TIM Performance and all-core Turbo Thermal Response

fig.title: Transient Tsn all-core Turbo Example: 15W TDP Package

body.note: 1 Analysis assumes fan running at full speed and maximum operating temperature.
body.p: Reducing the thermal impedance of the thermal interface material (RTIM) can significantly increase the time that the processor can operate in full turbo power (PL2) prior to reaching maximum operating temperature. This additional headroom can also be used to increase PL2 power for a targeted duration (Power Capability) to optimize for specific workloads. Intel recommends full PL2 power support for ≥ 3 to 5 seconds to meet target performance for representative bursty workloads.
